title: PLA Glue Gun Sticks
author: harald.bruns
description:
Reupload of existing design from FormFutura on Printables ( https://www.printables.com/model/855880-ribbed-glue-gun-sticks)

### **Description:**

You have a little bit of filament left so these Ribbed Sticks can be used for fixing and glueing your other projects. To prevent wasting all the small bits and pieces. The ridges make sure your glue gun can grip the stick.

Blog About this design:

https://formfutura.com/blog/pla-glue-sticks/

### Instructions:

You can use the Ribbed Sticks in your average hot glue gun with a diameter of 10mm

To use the Ribbed Sticks in a smaller glue gun you can also scale it down.

Print the Ribbed Sticks with 100% infill to make sure you make efficient use of space.

glue gluegun sticks repair tool tools pkp 18 e
